summary: Jesus Egg That Wept is the second solo album by Danielle Dax, an English experimental musician and former member of The Lemon Kittens. The album was originally recorded and released in 1984 on Awesome Records. It was re-released in 1993 on the Biter Of Thorpe label (catalogue BOT131-02CD) and distributed through World Serpent Distribution.
one_line: Jesus Egg That Wept is Danielle Dax's 1984 second solo album, re-released in 1993 on Biter Of Thorpe.
